# validate/events_at_missing — no request sets events_at, so there is no
# events producer; exactly one is required.

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_stdout.txt

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  url:
    type: url
    default: "http://localhost:9999"

auth:
  none: {}

requests:
  - method: GET
    url: {ref: state.url}

pagination:
  none: {}

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_stdout.txt --
requests: error: exactly one request must set events_at to mark the events producer; got 0
